metadata.title: ट्राइबल किचन : केंकड़ा, दाल बड़ा और बाजरा रोटी | Fresh Crab | Crab Curry | Tribal Food | MP Adivasi
metadata.description: Alirajpur district of MP is home to Bhilana tribe. The tribals here has a very rich culture and cook very tasty food. We visited a family in Thodsindhi village and got a chance to cook crab with a tribal family.
